title: Relationship Check-In Mood Trend
dataSources: Relationship check-ins (`relationship:checkin`), date nights (`datenight:log`), gift ideas (`giftidea:item`), keep-in-touch contacts (`keptintouch:contact`).
app: Relationship and togetherness logs — shared check-in apps, date-night and gift-idea lists, and stay-in-touch reminders — sent to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=relationship:checkin
| timechart span=1w avg(satisfaction) as satisfaction by partner
description: Trends how each of you rates the relationship over time in shared check-ins, catching drift before it grows.
value: A gentle, shared satisfaction trend opens honest conversations while issues are still small and easy to address.
implementation: Ingest mutual check-in ratings into `index=personal`; schedule weekly and trend satisfaction.
visualization: Line chart of relationship satisfaction over time.
grandmaExplanation: It tracks how happy you both feel in your relationship over time, so you can talk things through early.
